evidence: Frontline plan_state.py approve returned authorization requires a runtime session id before using the supplied session; the subsequent execution_evidence.py authorize removed approval-challenge.json while authorization.json kept the prior challenge and session.
failure: Fresh Ready-to-build approval for an already-approved brief routed through the initial approval command, then a reauthorization interruption consumed the one-use challenge without replacing the stale authorization receipt.
disposition_reason: Removed by design on 2026-09-02: Ready-to-build approval is one plain yes recorded once with no challenge code, expiry, or one-use consumption, so no reauthorization handoff exists to strand.
root_cause: The published approval workflow is not state-aware and challenge consumption is committed before the replacement authorization receipt, so reauthorization can take the wrong consumer and an interruption can strand the workflow.
